thread:
samir: Heads up — we're seeing a config drift in model-routing that’s causing intermittent 500s from the Dedicated GPU pool in ap-southeast1. Impacting ~8% of requests. I pushed a hotfix candidate v1.2.3 to the release branch. Need expedited deploy window.

deploy-bot: Release v1.2.3 detected. Patch: 'fix: routing table rebuild on scale-down'. Suggested deploy command: `/deploy release v1.2.3 --region ap-southeast1 --canary 5%`. Required approvals: 2 engineers + oncall.

kate: What are rollback criteria? if we hit error spike or latency regression. please specify numbers.

morgan: Impact: HA proxy 5xx rate from the pool jumped from 0.7% -> 8.3% over last 18m. CPU and GPU utilization normal. Looks config-only.

oncall-sre: Logs: `2026-03-20T10:12:03Z ERROR routing: lookup failed for model-id=redwood-open-2` — stack shows race when instance removal updates routing cache. I attached short tail: ```
ERROR routing: cache miss for key=...
panic: nil pointer in route rebuild
```

lena: Heads up — we have DB schema migration starting in 30m in ap-southeast1 for analytics. Can we avoid overlapping? That maintenance may spike infra noise.

samir: Understood. This is high-severity user-facing errors; if we wait 30m more we keep users degraded. Proposal: small canary (5%) now with strict rollback and 15-min watch, hold full rollout until migration completes.

pm-ryan: From product side — ok to proceed with limited canary if we have auto-rollback rules. Request we add a note in the release notes: "hotfix routing cache rebuild" and ping support.

kate: Approve for canary 5% now. Conditions: auto-rollback if 5xx > 2% or latency P95 increases > 200ms for 3 consecutive minutes. Also need post-deploy smoke check commands.

oncall-sre: I approve with those thresholds. I'll watch and can trigger rollback. My runbook snippet: ```
# smoke
curl -sS https://ap-southeast1.api.redwood.ai/health | jq .status
for i in $(seq 1 100); do curl -sS -H 'x-test:1' https://ap-southeast1.api.redwood.ai/generate > /dev/null; done
```

samir: approved :fire: — I'll kick off canary now. Deploy command I will run: 
```
/deploy release v1.2.3 --region ap-southeast1 --canary 5% --watch 15m --rollback-if '5xx>2% or p95+200ms'
```

deploy-bot: Confirming: starting canary for v1.2.3 in ap-southeast1 (5%). Notifying oncall-sre and #support. Auto-rollback rule set.

morgan: Watching metrics dashboard. Creating temporary chart for 5xx and p95.

lena: Thanks for the stagger. I'll delay the DB migration start by 20m and update infra calendar.

pm-ryan: Support notified. Adding short release note: "Hotfix v1.2.3 — routing cache rebuild to fix intermittent 500s in ap-southeast1. Canary rollout 5% with auto-rollback."
